references.text: Isaiah prophesies about God's judgment on His people and compares them to a vineyard that does not bear good fruit.
Daniel uses the parable of a king who plants a vineyard as a metaphor for God's people.
Jesus tells a similar parable about the workers in the vineyard, pointing to God's kingdom and justice.
Luke gives a parallel account to Matthew regarding the vineyard owners, emphasizing God's righteous judgment and grace.
God's promise to Noah after the flood can be seen as an early indication of God's patience and willingness to give humanity a new chance, paralleling the idea of giving the vineyard to new workers.
